needs_human.note: On non-US layouts, a Ctrl/Alt+Shift chord that produces a character in the US table is rewritten to the US unshifted face. For example, JIS Shift+2 gives '"', which becomes "'", and JIS Shift+; gives '+', which becomes '='. Shifted characters that are not in the table (for example JIS Shift+7, which gives "'") pass through unchanged.; On macOS, Option+Shift chords produce dead-key or special characters that are not in the table, so they are not mapped.
